scope: H4: mark nonzero process exits as structured errors without incorrect usage hints, and preserve failure worklog state.

libraries.verified: H4: McpServerToolAttribute.UseStructuredContent = true advertises an output schema and serializes typed results into CallToolResult.StructuredContent (JsonElement?); other non-string results are also serialized into a JSON text Content block. CallToolResult.IsError is nullable bool, set to true for classified non-zero exit failures.
